author: Wayneone70
quote: Plus for GTA6 is. Looks nice. That's about it. But hey. I'm reviewing a game not Google Maps.. 30fps for a 13 year game in the making is shocking. Had to keep taking a break as it made me feel sick and eye strain. And before these user reviews get taken down. No my Internet is bang on. So shouldn't be any framerate issues. Now. On with the characters. Wow. Jason is a weak pathetic boring character who just simps for his latino girlfriend lucia. Chooses what she wears. Agrees with her. Does the housework. You decorate the house. Buy her flowers and blah blah blah. Booooring. Missions are also boring. The whole game when i did a bit of free roam is restricted. The humour has long gone from the previous GTA games i loved from the days of Vice City. San Andreas. GTA4 and even GTA5. Playing GTA6 in 2026 doesn't even raise me a smile. It's cringe worthy and an embarrassment. Also you know there is a hidden agenda. Yeah you know newbie GTA fans will love the "Oh so beautiful graphics" but hey. From an oldskool Rockstar Games fan. I loved the franchise because of the hilarious characters and writing. The freedom in the game. The hilarious radio stations. But nah. GTA6 tried but failed on all levels for me. And you know what Rockstar Games. There is no coming back from this.
